commentary.text: 90+6' That's the end of the match.
90+6' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Julien Le Cardinal (Brest) comes onto the pitch so that Romain Del Castillo can be given a rest.
90+5' Eric Roy decides to make a substitution. Hugo Magnetti will be replaced by Bilal Brahimi (Brest).
90+1' 2 - 0 Jeremy Le Douaron (Brest) scores as he latches on to a pass inside the penalty box and fires a perfect low strike, which goes inside the left post.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Maxime Esteve (Montpellier) wins himself just enough space inside the box to connect with the corner, but his header is well saved by the keeper.
90' There's an opportunity for Teji Savanier (Montpellier) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
89' Jeremy Le Douaron (Brest) fires the ball on goal but sends it into orbit.
88' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
87' The ball is cleared after Jeremy Le Douaron (Brest) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
87' Bradley Locko (Brest) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
86' Pierre Lees-Melou (Brest) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
83' Martin Satriano (Brest) unleashes a missile of a shot towards goal, but his good effort is blocked by one of the defenders.
81' Hugo Magnetti (Brest) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
80' Martin Satriano (Brest) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom right corner, but Benjamin Lecomte has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
79' Montpellier failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
78' 20:5 – the total goal attempt statistics.
76' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Brest will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
76' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Mahdi Camara leaves the pitch and Jonas Martin (Brest) comes on.
76' Here is a change. Steve Mounie is going off and Eric Roy gives the last tactical orders to Martin Satriano (Brest).
73' Substitution. Arnaud Nordin (Montpellier) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Khalil Fayad walks off.
72' Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) has a sight of goal and shoots from long range but his ambitious effort flies just wide of the right post.
70' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.
68' Jeremy Le Douaron (Brest) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Benjamin Lecomte.
67' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) comes onto the pitch for Akor Adams.
67' Michel Der Zakarian prepares a substitution. Joris Chotard is replaced by Leo Leroy (Montpellier).
66' A substitution has been made. Mathias Pereira Lage is replaced by Jeremy Le Douaron (Brest).

65' Mahdi Camara (Brest) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the middle of the goal. His effort, however, is blocked by Benjamin Lecomte, who pulls off a comfortable save!
63' 66:34 – the latest ball possession ratio.
60' What a huge chance for Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest). He collects a precise pass inside the box and slices a shot that goes a whisker wide of the left post.
59' Steve Mounie (Brest) climbs above the defence to meet the free kick, but plants his header high over the bar from close range.
58' It seemed like Romain Del Castillo (Brest) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
57' Christopher Jullien (Montpellier) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
55' Joris Chotard (Montpellier) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.

54' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Brest are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
50' Mahdi Camara (Brest) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.
48' 1 - 0 Hugo Magnetti (Brest) receives a killer pass, finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and coolly sends the ball into the back of the net.
46' Steve Mounie (Brest) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Montpellier are awarded a free kick.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Michel Der Zakarian gives a chance to Jordan Ferri (Montpellier) and Becir Omeragic is off.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Mahdi Camara (Brest) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
45+1' 2 additional min. will be played.
45' Hugo Magnetti (Brest) gets booked for the first time in this match.
44' Joris Chotard (Montpellier) is cautioned and receives a yellow card.
44' Joris Chotard (Montpellier) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
43' Montpellier are ruled offside.
42' Kenny Lala (Brest) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players.
41' Brest will take a corner kick.
40' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
38' Montpellier concede a free kick following a bad challenge. There is a free kick near the sideline to Brest.
37' Bradley Locko (Brest) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
36' Kelvin Yeboah (Montpellier) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
35' Steve Mounie (Brest) latched on to an accurate cross inside the box and attempted to direct the ball with a nice header towards the net, but the goalkeeper reacted quickly to keep the ball out.
34' Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
32' Marco Bizot leaps to intercept the corner kick from Teji Savanier (Montpellier).
31' Khalil Fayad (Montpellier) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.
29' Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Benjamin Lecomte, who smothers the ball.

28' Akor Adams (Montpellier) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the bottom right corner, but Marco Bizot thwarts him with a great two-handed save.
26' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.
23' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The Brest players look gutted.
23' Wait! Referee Jeremie Pignard has indicated he is going to review the Brest goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
21' It's a goal! Steve Mounie (Brest) does well to meet a cross inside the box and strikes a perfect header low inside the right post.
20' Steve Mounie (Brest) blows a huge opportunity from inside the 6-yard box. He pounced on a rebound but headed it just over the crossbar.
18' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
17' Mahdi Camara (Brest) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
16' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
15' Joris Chotard (Montpellier) sends a cross into the box, but Marco Bizot comes off his line to gather the ball.
14' An attempted cross from Romain Del Castillo (Brest) is cleared.
13' Brest enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
10' Mahdi Camara (Brest) sends a weak shot high over the bar from the edge of the box. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Montpellier.
10' Akor Adams (Montpellier) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area.
9' Michel Der Zakarian is forced to make a change. Tanguy Coulibaly is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Kelvin Yeboah (Montpellier).
8' Hugo Magnetti (Brest) unleashed a powerful long-range strike, but the ball was blocked by a defender on its way.
6' Tanguy Coulibaly (Montpellier) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
5' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear.
5' The free kick from long range, taken by Brest, is overhit and the ball goes out of play.
4' Jeremie Pignard blows for a foul after Teji Savanier (Montpellier) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. Brest have a free kick.
3' A long pass, executed by Kenny Lala (Brest), missed the precision to reach his teammates.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Montpellier will kick the game off.
Jeremie Pignard will referee today's match.
